picks.game: Kansas City Royals vs Toronto Blue Jays
picks.rationale: The Kansas City Royals enter this game on an impressive eight-game winning streak, demonstrating strong recent form. Despite public money favoring Toronto, the line has shifted more favorably towards Kansas City, suggesting sharp action on the underdog. Toronto has dropped two of its last three games, including a series loss to the Yankees, indicating some recent struggles. With Kansas City's momentum and a more favorable pitching matchup against Toronto, the Royals present good value as an underdog.

picks.game: Milwaukee Brewers vs New York Mets
picks.rationale: The Milwaukee Brewers offense is one of the best in baseball, and they are facing a Mets team with a depleted lineup due to injuries to Juan Soto (calf strain) and Mark Vientos (hand issue). While Mets rookie Zach Thornton has a decent ERA, underlying metrics suggest regression is coming, and the Mets bullpen has been poor, especially after recent deadline trades. Despite Kyle Harrison's strong pitching for Milwaukee, the Brewers tend to limit his innings, bringing their bullpen into play earlier. With neutral weather conditions in Queens, there's a good chance for runs, making the Over 7.5 an attractive play.

picks.game: Texas Rangers vs Chicago White Sox
picks.rationale: The Texas Rangers have Jacob deGrom on the mound, who is coming off a dominant outing with 10 strikeouts over six scoreless innings. deGrom holds a clear starting pitching advantage over Chicago's Anthony Kay, whose underlying metrics are less convincing despite a decent ERA. The Rangers' offense has been strong since June 1, posting a 127 wRC+ and a .352 wOBA, even with Josh Jung sidelined. With Texas having won four of their last five games and a significant pitching mismatch, the Rangers moneyline offers value.

picks.game: Cleveland Guardians vs Los Angeles Angels
picks.rationale: Both starting pitchers, Gavin Williams for the Guardians and Walbert Ureña for the Angels, have shown strong recent form, particularly Ureña at home with a 2.27 ERA. Both teams have been involved in lower-scoring games recently, with a combined 13-4-1 record to the under in their last 18 games. The bullpens for both Cleveland and Los Angeles have been in excellent form, boasting a combined 3.77 ERA over their last 10 games. Given the strong pitching and recent low-scoring trends, the Under 7.5 is a confident pick.

The Philadelphia Phillies, despite having their nine-game winning streak snapped, have been red-hot offensively, boasting the second-highest scoring offense in August. Seattle Mariners starter George Kirby has struggled recently, allowing at least three earned runs in six straight starts and owning a poor 5.57 SIERA over the last 30 days. Kirby has particularly struggled against left-handed bats, which the Phillies are well-equipped to exploit with players like Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper. With the Phillies' strong offensive form and Kirby's recent struggles, Philadelphia has a clear edge in this matchup.
